thread:
Nina: Heads-up — admin modal "Suggest Grants" for tenant y-77 is rendering thousands of identical lines. Console becomes unresponsive and our suggestions endpoint is getting slammed.
Arjun: Can you repro steps? Is it one tenant with a large route graph?
Nina: Yes. Steps: Tenant -> Settings -> Permissions -> Suggest Grants. It enumerates per-route and duplicates the same capability suggestion across ~340 routes.
Pat: Telemetry shows suggest_api.requests spiked and permission-graph returned a bunch of 5xx/429s: 
```
POST /v1/perm/suggest  -> 429 Too Many Requests
{"tenant":"y-77","routes_examined":340}
```
Maya (Console): UX idea: collapse identical suggestions into a single line that says "340 matching API endpoints" with an expand control. Keep a short sample of endpoints (3) and an "Export list" link for audits.
Arjun: Backend option: instead of N permission-graph traversals, compute capability -> matching routes in one traversal and emit grouped suggestions. That should cut graph calls dramatically.
Pat: Implementation caveat: our route names aren't normalized so grouping will create false positives for paramized paths. We'll need a canonicalization step: strip tenant prefix and normalize `:{param}` segments to `{*}`.
Maya (Console): Also we should show a confidence score and why the suggestion was generated (e.g., "observed calls from service A to route B"). That helps admins accept in bulk.
ops-bot: alert: suggest-service p95 latency increased from 1.8s to 4.2s for tenant y-77; rate limiters engaged.
Nina: For safety, default to grouped view when routes_count > 50. Offer a per-capability fallback to expand into full per-route detail on demand.
Arjun: We'll add a query param `group=true|false` to the suggest API and a server-side flag to automatically enable grouping for large tenants. Also emit metric tag `suggestions.grouped=true/false`.
Pat: Rollout plan: enable grouped suggestions behind feature flag `permissions.grouped_suggest_canary`. Start at 5% tenants, verify lower error rates and better modal performance.
Maya (Console): UI interactions: collapsed row shows badge "340 matching" + hover for pattern rule. Expand will load the full list lazily (page fetch) to avoid modal freeze. Provide inline search input too.
Nina: Quota implications: grouping means fewer permission-graph calls per suggest invocation — update tenant quota meter and the quota-overview dashboard to reflect lower burn.
Arjun: Edge case: if grouping algorithm confidence < 0.7, surface a warning and provide "Show exact routes" by default for that capability. We'll log confidence in telemetry.
Pat: Tests: unit tests for canonicalizer, integration test comparing grouped vs per-route outputs, e2e for console rendering.
Maya (Console): I'll prototype Figma screens with collapsed rows, samples, and tooltip text explaining grouping. Also add an "Export CSV" button for auditors.
ops-bot: scheduled deploy: suggest-service v2 (includes grouping) -> canary rollout 2024-11-15T04:00Z.
Arjun: Action items: 1) backend PR with grouping + metric tags + param, 2) canonicalizer lib in infra, 3) feature flag and canary, 4) update quota dashboard.
Maya (Console): Action items for console: implement collapsed UX, lazy expand, search, csv export, and confidence badge copy.
Nina: I'll draft a short RFC summarizing UX and metrics we will track: suggestion_count, grouped_ratio, api_rate_limit_errors, suggestion_accept_rate, modal_render_time.
Pat: I'll instrument telemetry and add dashboard panels for canary cohort.
Nina: Great. Thanks everyone — let's sync next week for canary results. :rocket:
